CustomField.description: Controls whether the designation is available on new gifts. An active GiftDesignation cannot be deleted — attempting to delete raises "You can't delete an active designation." Correct teardown pattern: set IsActive = false, update, then delete. Deactivation does not affect existing GiftTransactionDesignation rows that reference the designation; historical allocations remain intact. See docs/npc-automation-notes.md.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Uncheck to retire this designation. Retired designations stay on historical gifts but won't appear when adding new gifts.
